newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM Litho seeks to dispel fears over share.
newsitem.headline: ASM Litho seeks to dispel fears over share.

text.p: Dutch high-technology firm ASM Lithography Holdings NV moved on Tuesday to dispel fears over its falling share price by repeating that it expects 1996 earnings to meet analysts' forecasts.

"Prompted by recent negative developments on (the) share price, ASML...wishes to reiterate that there is no reason to believe that the profit per share will not meet this expectation," it said in a statement.
In July, ASML said that it was comfortable with analysts' estimates for full year 1996 earnings of 6.00 to 7.00 guilders per share.

The company also reiterated that it expected 1997 sales turnover and results would be higher than in 1996, "although there remains many uncertainties in the market developments in the next 12 months."
ASML had 1995 turnover of 917.7 million guilders.
ASML shares were at a year high of 87.40 on February 22, but have since fallen away to below 59 guilders.
In early Tuesday trading ASML shares gained 1.10 to 59.90 guilders.
